[[Chief Technician]] '''Ablee Bansak''' was a mid-level maintenance [[Technician/Legends|technician]] working at [[Estaria Central Starport]]. He managed a team of ten technicians and was also a member of the [[Rebel cell]] that maintained the [[Estaria Cache]] alongside Cargo Supervisor [[Hev Lissona]] and Freight Administrator [[Ela Harns]].<ref name="HS" />
